subject: Quick check — any blockers on the SOC 2 packet and next steps?
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@regenia.ai>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@regenia.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + SOC 2 packet (post-call)

Hi Elena and Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Action items we covered:
  • I shared the SOC 2 packet and a one-page summary highlighting control areas relevant to data residency and logging. (Attached.)
  • You asked for an index of artifact evidence we can surface for your audit — we've started an evidence index (attached).
  • We discussed a canary rollout plan and timing windows for integration testing in early Jan.

- Next steps
  1) I'll follow up with the SOC 2 summary + evidence index by EOD today (attached).
  2) If there are any blockers on security/compliance, please flag them so we can prioritize responses.
  3) If helpful, happy to schedule a short call next week with our security engineer (Ben) to walk through specifics.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary_v1.pdf (summary), Redwood_SOC2-evidence-index.csv (index), Regenia_Rollout-MAP.xlsx (shared MAP).

Would you say this remains a priority this quarter? If timelines shifted, tell me and we can adapt.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena@regenia.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SOC 2 packet (post-call)

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the packet and the clear recap. I skimmed the summary this morning. A couple of quick notes from our side: 

1) Data residency: we need confirmation about where logs and customer data are stored for private deployments. The summary mentions options but I couldn't find explicit region mappings in the doc.
2) Evidence: the evidence-index looks helpful. Can you confirm which items we can expect to receive as downloadable artifacts vs. screenshots? For audit purposes we prefer downloadable artifacts where possible.

We have an internal compliance sync Monday; if you can send a short note addressing these two points before then, that would be great.

On the MAP, Tom (cc'd) asked whether you support contract start dates that align with calendar months (easier for procurement).

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Security & Compliance
Regenia.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@regenia.ai>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@regenia.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SOC 2 packet (post-call)

Hi Elena — thanks, great questions. Short answers below and a note on artifacts: 

1) Data residency: For Private/VPC deployments you can pin region at deployment time. Our SOC 2 summary now includes a short table mapping typical deployment options to region storage (see page 2). If you need an explicit region-of-record statement for procurement, we can provide a signed addendum — we have standard language we use with customers.

2) Evidence artifacts: the evidence index indicates which items are downloadable artifacts (PDFs/log extracts) vs. screen captures. I've highlighted the downloadable items in the "downloadable" column (CSV). If you need a packaged artifact bundle for audit ingestion we can produce one — Ben can scope required extraction.

3) Contract start alignment: We can accommodate calendar-month start dates for most standard setups — procurement-friendly. We'll confirm firm dates once SOW is finalized.

If helpful, can we schedule a 30-min walkthrough with Ben on Monday (Nov 23) at 10am PT to run through evidence items? I'll leave that as a proposed slot but happy to adjust.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary_v1.pdf (now with region table), Redwood_SOC2-evidence-index.csv (downloadable flagged).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@regenia.ai>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@regenia.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Checking in — any blockers after the SOC 2 packet?

Hi Elena / Tom —

Just following up on the SOC 2 materials I sent Saturday and the proposed walkthrough. We haven't heard back and I wanted to check whether anything is blocking your review or if timelines/priorities changed on your side. Quick options: 

- If you need a packaged artifact bundle for the audit, Ben can prepare a scoped export by EOD Wed.
- If you'd like a short technical call, Ben and I are available Tue/Wed next week — tell us a preferred time.
- If the project timeline shifted, let us know the new target and we'll adjust the MAP and internal resources.

Short answers to the points you raised: region mapping and downloadable artifacts are available; we can provide a signed region addendum and produce downloadable exports. I'll loop Ben directly when you confirm which artifacts you need.

If I don't hear back by Thursday I'll assume this moved down your priority list and will follow up in two weeks. Appreciate a quick thumbs-up either way.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
